description: Did a deploy break anything? Compares the hours after it (up to 24 h) with the 24 h before: error rate, new errors, response time, paid conversion and revenue per visit. Verdict: looks fine, worse or too early. Default: the latest deploy; pick another by version or at. Correlation, not proof.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

at.description: The deploy's time (ISO), for deploys without a usable version
